note: Draft register for Spec 047 (design D-09, PR #195 packet), opened 2026-10-21 under the runnable-experiments campaign plan approved by the owner as written the same date (D-09 = member 8; Asset B built inside this spec per E-6). Conventions as in Specs 032–042: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-GAZETTEER-SPINE (the Spec 027 Stage 0 gazetteer, as pinned, is the site universe), ASM-PRIMARY-LAYER (the pinned Yajnadevam-compiled layer is the site-attributed corpus of record), ASM-PHASE104-RECORD (Phase-104's evaluation is the claim's record of standing), ASM-TWO-SOURCE-RULE (the design's two-source agreement rule is the classification's warrant), ASM-EXCAVATION-LITERATURE (published excavation/site literature states site functions admissibly), ASM-SHARES-CONTROL (comparing shares rather than counts is the design's size control), ASM-ROIF-SOURCE-POSTINGS (the 2025 Academia.edu postings are Roif's work of record, per the 2026-10-21 verification), ASM-COMPONENT-DECOMPOSITION (a bundled claim is adjudicated component by component), ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME (integrity and classification gates precede any outcome quantity), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; frozen records are never edited), ASM-ROIF-GATE (campaign R-7 holds this member's results internal until the owner's publication act).

claims.text: An outcome under Spec 047 states only how inscriptions and Roif's named ledger-sign classes distribute across the frozen site-function classes of the Spec 027 gazetteer spine, in the pinned primary corpus layer.
claims.boundary: The scope is the distribution component of the claim, the 30-cluster gazetteer spine, its testable subset, and the primary layer. It excludes any statement about what any inscription records, about guilds, about Akkadian influence, about any other corpus or site set, and about Roif's thesis as a whole.
alternatives: the pooled claim-level verdict could be read as already covering the distribution question (it cannot: the claim stands UNTESTED for want of the classification this spec builds)
falsification_tests: the claim is falsified in scope if any Spec 047 output states a conclusion about a population, corpus, site set, or question outside the distribution component as bounded here

metadata.strongest_rival: the alternative reading in which a distribution verdict licenses a claim about the thesis as a whole
metadata.verdict_rule: scope is judged by inspection of every Spec 047 output against this boundary; any output exceeding it is a defect of the output, recorded as such, not a finding

claims.text: Every Asset B classification uses exactly the six classes of spec §4.2 — gateway/border, administrative, port/trade, domestic, ritual, mixed/unknown — assigned by the mapping rule stated there from what a published source states about the site's primary function.
claims.boundary: The vocabulary is closed, and the two derived groupings (pooled ADMIN-TRADE-GATEWAY; contrast domestic/ritual) are fixed in the same section. mixed/unknown belongs to neither grouping. No class may be added, split, or merged inside this campaign; a vocabulary defect is an amendment, not an edit.

claims.text: If fewer than 12 sites are testable under the two-source rule, or if either the pooled class or the contrast class is empty in the test population, the distribution test does not run: the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE with the classification itself as the finding, its disagreements published in full, and no distribution quantity computed.
claims.boundary: The 12-site floor is design D-09's, carried verbatim. The empty-side clause is this draft's completion of the same gate (DD-047-2): with one side empty the §6.2 ratio is undefined, so no quantity can honestly be computed. Asset B still freezes in this case; the floor is a test gate, not a build gate (F047-C12).
alternatives: computing the shares anyway on a thin classification because the numbers would be interesting (refused: the design makes the classification the finding in exactly this case)
falsification_tests: the step-2 record either shows the testable count at or above 12 with both sides non-empty before the first distribution quantity, or it shows the INCONCLUSIVE-classification wording and no quantities; anything else falsifies compliance

evidence.description: Design D-09 (PR #195 packet, §D-09, read in full at this draft): the question, hypothesis, falsifier, step-1 classification build under the two-source agreement rule, step-2 measures, and criteria this spec registers.

claims.text: The verdict is assigned mechanically by the partition of spec §6.3: SUPPORTED iff the ratio is at least 1.5, the permutation test (9,999 label shuffles) rejects at the 5% level, and the ledger-sign ratio exceeds 1.0; NOT SUPPORTED iff the ratio is at or below 1.0 or the permutation test does not reject; INCONCLUSIVE in every remaining case.
claims.boundary: No threshold, margin, shuffle count, or clause is adjusted for the observed data. The permutation seed is fixed at this spec's freeze and recorded in the freeze record, before any count exists. The partition is exhaustive: every (R, p, R_ledger) triple lands in exactly one outcome.
alternatives: re-deriving thresholds from the test population once its size is known (refused: the design fixes the 1.5 ratio, the 5% level, and the 9,999 shuffles in advance)
falsification_tests: the verdict assignment is mechanical from the recorded quantities; any verdict not following this rule from its run's numbers falsifies the outcome record, and any reader can recompute it

metadata.strongest_rival: post-hoc rule-shopping once the ratios are known — in particular, softening a permutation failure into INCONCLUSIVE contrary to the design's NOT SUPPORTED clause
metadata.verdict_rule: verdicts are recomputed from the published quantities by any reader; the rule text here and in spec §6.3 is frozen before execution

falsification_tests: an outcome product lacking either sensitivity, or carrying a headline word traceable to a sensitivity rather than to the §6.3 partition, falsifies compliance
